best_selection: Task-specific descriptive best: maximum completed-and-stopped ID count, tie earliest step. Study-level ID selection: maximum arrival, tie earliest step. OOD stays at250000.
raw_verification: Completed shards only; no duplicate task/trajectory_id within complete sets; counts match shard summaries
failure_classification: Mutually exclusive priority: completed, arrival_without_stop, output_error, premature_done, executed_unreachable_transition, repeated_state_and_budget, remaining_budget_or_no_successor. Last scored but unexecuted budget action excluded from unreachable detection.
notes: 完成率为到达且正确停止，跟图率使用原评测map_optimal口径。首表各任务独立选择ID正确完成数最高的已评点，同分取较早点，跟图率来自同一点。
Curves are strictly task-specific: every plotted checkpoint must contain the complete250-case ID set for that task; other tasks may still be incomplete at that checkpoint.
